model_public_input: existing MR15 8 camera-relative 3-byte observed tiles only
training_phase: diagnostic sampling only, NO learned weights or private model parameters
reference_criterion: for each next-frame public sampled triple, count 0, 1, or >=2 exact matches in the immediately prior eight public triples, without decoding their content
negative_controls: nonadjacent original public frame from another development episode, same source class
success_criterion: development source transition correspondence shows informative unique identifiable matches under native camera turns, distinguishable from nonadjacent-frame control; otherwise fail closed before learned identity mechanism
excluded: original env private grid or pose
